known_fixes: The existing Live Dev Server Dockerfile is hydration-only and cannot run as a standalone app-server image; added Dockerfile.codepress with source and lockfile installation.
The legacy CRA 1.0.10 dependency tree requires Node 18 because websocket-driver uses the legacy http_parser binding.
The official Node 18 image already provides a Corepack Yarn shim; pinned Yarn 1.22.22 with Corepack instead of replacing it globally.
discovery_notes: This repository contains a legacy Create React App 1.0.10 frontend under web/ and a separate Django 1.11 server under server/. The only existing Dockerfile is a Live Dev Server hydration image, so the app-server recipe targets the public web frontend with a dedicated Node 18 image that copies web/ and installs web/yarn.lock in the image; no database, cache, auth, or external API is required for the rendered home page.
